natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%; renewals weak.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction improved early adoption. Verify the archived records before testing a narrowly scoped simplification, while monitoring lead quality, activation, and qualified revenue to avoid trading downstream value for completion gains.
